values.note: Sites 1-7 have 50-amp electric (6 & 7 full service), sites 8-50 have 30-amp; numerous additional dry-camping sites.

note: Town of Valier campground on a shoreline peninsula of Lake Frances; two boat ramps, fish-cleaning station and playground. Caretaker-managed (camp host on site May 1-Sept 20); walleye/pike fishery. --Claude
summary: Town page confirms 50 electric sites (1-7 50-amp, 6 & 7 full service, 8-50 30-amp) plus extra dry sites, dump with potable fill, FCFS with no reservations, phone 406-279-3361. Note corrected: it said sites 8+ were dry, the page says 30-amp. No nightly rate or campground season posted (only $800/month for sites 6 & 7).
flags: No nightly rate posted on the town page; the only fee shown is $800/month for full-service sites 6 & 7. Fees left unrecorded.
